answer: Each identity locks 70 credits, claims a garden plot, and files a survey per epoch. A cipher seal binds each survey to its key and epoch. The summit ledger holds each survey for replay. One key signing two surveys, or two identities sharing one, proves duplication; both burn. A rented-survey ring cannot hide. Filings cost 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files a survey, pays 35, and keeps its bond.
